{{dablink|For other uses of the term "''Wheel of Time''," see ''[[Wheel of Time (disambiguation)|Wheel of Time]]''.}}
'''''The Wheel of Time'' Concordance''', by Rhonda Peters, is "A Guide to Geography, Culture and Other Setting Elements'" of ''The Wheel of Time'' series and was one of the first resources on fine details of the series.

It's prime purpose was as a resource for roleplaying in the world of The Wheel of Time, specifically the [[Wheel of Time MUD]]. This is not an official adaptation of the books like the later [[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game|Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]], although it had a very active community for many years

As a resource, it has a lot of detail, but is extremely out of date. Its last major update (ver. 3.1) appears to be after the publication of [[The Path of Daggers]] around 1998 and is unlikely to see any further updates.

As of 2024, a group headed by 'Matrim Farshaw' has been put together to rebuild the Concordance from scratch, into a version 4.0, which aims to surpass the original Concordance 3.1 in detail and completeness.
